description_for_human: Content-addressed AI memory with tamper-evident SHA-256 receipts. On-chain zero-knowledge verification is in development.
description_for_model: Returns a SHA-256 content-addressed receipt binding the returned memory result to its content hash. This is not a Groth16 or ZK-STARK proof and does not independently prove execution. An on-chain verifiable proof circuit is under development and is not yet deployed.
